news.title: Taiwan will invest $250 billion in U.S. chipmaking under new trade deal
news.description: The U.S. and Taiwan have reached a trade agreement to build chips and chip factories on American soil, the Department of Commerce announced on Thursday.

news.title: Chip stocks pop after TSMC's earnings beat boosts confidence in industrywide demand
news.description: Shares of chipmakers AMD and Nvidia popped along with equipment makers like Applied Materials after TSMC reported better-than-expected results.

news.title: Amazon threatens 'drastic' action after Saks bankruptcy, says $475M stake is now worthless
news.description: Amazon invested $475 million into Saks' acquisition of Neiman Marcus. It wants a federal judge to reject Saks' bankruptcy plan because it harms creditors.
